verdict.rationale: ADK docs explicitly cover 'Exposing ADK Tools via an MCP Server' (a guide for wrapping ADK tools so any MCP client can connect), which flips the axis from the default agent-as-client exclusion to an applicable server-mode capability. However, this is documented as a 'how to build' guide rather than a pre-built, hosted official MCP server, and the more prominent documented pattern in ADK is being an MCP client consuming external servers (docs-4/20), not exposing one for others to connect to. Missing for 10: a ready-made/official hosted MCP server endpoint (vs. a build-it-yourself guide), independent/hands-on verification that external agents can connect to an ADK-exposed MCP server.
